What this card is
drawn from

Two sources, and every part of this card says which one it came from. The pages and the words are the Makadina sales kit, 27 pages supplied. The units, prices and payment terms are the developer’s price list, as supplied in the client sheet.

Nothing here has been calculated, rounded or completed from another project. Where a source is silent this card says so rather than filling the gap, which is why no price per m² appears: the sheet does not carry one and working it out would be a calculation.

The kit publishes no floor plan and no price. It names the eight products on its Phase I layout — Villa A, Villa B, Villa C, Villa D, Twin House, Townhouse and Apartment Buildings A and B — and the price list carries ten rows against them.

What to check with the developer

  • The sheet lists two Apartment rows more than the kit’s two apartment buildings, and one Twin House against the kit’s one confirm
  • The kit gives no floor plan for any product, so no unit here carries one kit silent
  • The kit gives no price, no down payment and no instalment term kit silent

Illustrative. Every page and render on this card is Travco Properties’ own, reproduced from the sales kit for illustrative purposes only. Drawings are not to scale; areas, dimensions and specifications are subject to change without prior notice.

Accuracy. Every number and name is reproduced as its source gives it. Kit pages run in the kit’s order; units run in the sheet’s order. Where the two disagree the card says so above and uses the sheet.

Before quoting a client. Prices, payment terms and the availability year come from the price list and are illustrative. Confirm current pricing and availability with Travco Properties or an advisor, and settle the queries above first.
